findings.detail: Gemini was treated as an active autonomous agent/execution engine rather than an API endpoint evaluated via Node.js runtime (PromptGemini / send-to-gemini.js) within GitHub Actions.
The candidate introduced an ungrounded 25MB archive threshold and an invented standalone workflow YAML instead of adhering to the documented JS Runner execution model and existing workflow triggers.

The script hardcodes an unvalidated HTTP fetch contract and arbitrary report structure rather than grounding parameter types and return shapes in the verified Apps Script doPost bridge contract ({sourcecode, arguments}).

procedure.json labels itself response_type 'ai_nlep' but omits mandatory MetaProcedure sections: procedure_metadata, definitions, instructions.operations, state_model, transition_model, verification_model, error_model, procedure_execution_semantics, and self_evaluation.

payload_contract.arguments: object passed as input to sourcecode

architecture_basis.execution_locus: GitHub Actions Node.js runner executes JS Runner, which dispatches payload to Apps Script endpoint and persists execution receipt to local filesystem.

document_revision.proposed_schema_reconciliation: Promote procedure.json to a full ai_nlep specification compliant with 731942_ai_nlep_meta_procedure.json, eliminating hallucinated file size caps and fictitious agent roles.

unresolved: Precise Drive Takeout ZIP inspection requirements without arbitrary in-memory decompression caps (e.g. streaming or metadata-only inspection when handling large files in Apps Script)
Exact structure of the Drive inspection report artifact created in Google Drive vs repository-persisted audit receipt
Alignment with existing workflow invocation pattern without adding redundant GitHub Action workflows
next_pass_focus: Pass 2: Deconstruct MetaProcedure requirements (P1-P20, operational explicitness, interface congruence, action vs effect verification) and define the exact Apps Script sourcecode payload semantics.
